title: Grade 4 CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — General Assessment #9

pages.quiz:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #9
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In the parable, who does the woman stand for? (1 mark)
   A. A sinner
   B. God
   C. A shopkeeper
   D. A priest

2. What does the miracle show about Jesus? (1 mark)
   A. He has power over death
   B. He is only a teacher
   C. He is a weak man
   D. He is a king of Rome

3. What did Joseph advise Pharaoh to store during the good years? (1 mark)
   A. Half the animals
   B. Nothing
   C. One fifth of the harvest
   D. All the harvest

4. What position did Pharaoh give Joseph? (1 mark)
   A. Second in command over Egypt
   B. Shepherd
   C. Soldier
   D. Priest

5. What is the best way to respond when someone teases you about your appearance? (1 mark)
   A. Stop going to school
   B. Change your name
   C. Tease them back
   D. Remember that God made you special and tell a trusted adult if it continues

6. Which chore shows responsibility at home? (1 mark)
   A. Washing plates
   B. Complaining
   C. Breaking plates
   D. Hiding

7. Where is the parable of the mustard seed found in Luke? (1 mark)
   A. Luke 13:18-19
   B. Luke 15:8
   C. Luke 1:37
   D. Luke 19:5

8. Which Gospel records the healing of Bartimaeus? (1 mark)
   A. Acts
   B. Romans
   C. Genesis
   D. Mark

9. Why does no other person have the same fingerprints as you? (1 mark)
   A. Every person is unique
   B. Fingerprints are drawn at birth
   C. Only twins have fingerprints
   D. Fingerprints change every day

10. What does gratitude mean? (1 mark)
   A. Being angry
   B. Showing thanks
   C. Boasting
   D. Complaining

11. What should we do when we face problems? (1 mark)
   A. Hide
   B. Pray and ask for help
   C. Blame others
   D. Give up

12. What does the parable teach about every person? (1 mark)
   A. Every person is precious to God
   B. Nobody matters
   C. Only adults matter
   D. Only rich people matter

13. Which commandment forbids false testimony? (1 mark)
   A. Exodus 20:12
   B. Exodus 20:15
   C. Exodus 20:16
   D. Exodus 20:3

14. Which is an activity in church? (1 mark)
   A. Praying and singing
   B. Fighting
   C. Selling goods
   D. Playing football inside

15. What did Jesus pray on the cross? (1 mark)
   A. Father, send angels
   B. Father, take me away
   C. Father, forgive them
   D. Father, punish them

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Explain what "forgive" means. (2 marks)

17. Explain three ways in which children can show God's love to others. (3 marks)

18. Name two of the twelve disciples who were brothers. (2 marks)

19. Name two things that Samson did in Judges 14:5-9. (2 marks)

20. Give two sins that do not please God. (2 marks)

21. Name two things that can defile the body. (2 marks)

22. State two benefits of obeying parents. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #9 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — God
   The searching woman stands for God's love.

2. A — He has power over death
   Jesus is Lord of life.

3. C — One fifth of the harvest
   Genesis 41:34 says to take a fifth.

4. A — Second in command over Egypt
   Joseph was put in charge of Egypt, next to Pharaoh.

5. D — Remember that God made you special and tell a trusted adult if it continues
   God's view of you matters more than unkind words.

6. A — Washing plates
   Doing chores shows duty.

7. A — Luke 13:18-19
   Luke 13:18-19 contains the parable.

8. D — Mark
   Mark 10:46-52 tells the story.

9. A — Every person is unique
   Fingerprints show that each person is one of a kind.

10. B — Showing thanks
   Gratitude is being thankful.

11. B — Pray and ask for help
   We can bring our worries to God and to trusted adults.

12. A — Every person is precious to God
   God searches for each person.

13. C — Exodus 20:16
   Exodus 20:16 forbids false testimony.

14. A — Praying and singing
   Worship includes prayer and singing.

15. C — Father, forgive them
   Luke 23:34 records this prayer.

SECTION B
----
16. (2 marks)
   Answer: To stop being angry with someone and not pay them back for the wrong they did.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for stopping anger and 1 for not paying back.

17. (3 marks)
   Answer: Share, help the sick, forgive, speak kindly, include others.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each way.

18. (2 marks)
   Answer: Peter and Andrew; James and John.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each pair.

19. (2 marks)
   Answer: He killed a lion with his bare hands; he ate honey from the lion's body and shared it with his parents.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid action.

20. (2 marks)
   Answer: Lying, stealing, disobedience, bullying, jealousy.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

21. (2 marks)
   Answer: Alcohol, drugs, harmful media, sex outside marriage.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

22. (2 marks)
   Answer: Pleases God, peace at home, trust from parents, learning good habits.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid benefit.
